content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 - Elevated 5xx rate detected on prompt routing for the new endpoint prompt-edge-v2. Auto-safeguard triggered for feature flag `flag.prompt_edge_v2`. Paging @eng-oncall. Dashboard: https://observability.redwood.internal/alerts/1739123456

eng-oncall: On it — joining logs and routing. Can anyone validate canary vs stable diff?

samir: Looking. Canary hosts show repeated `kv_cache::lookup` NPEs plus `segfault` in the attention kernel on 2 hosts. Spike aligns with the rollout at 12:03 UTC.

jess: If safeguard already paused the flag we should confirm and drain canaries. Command to flip if needed:```bash
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/v1/toggle 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAGS_OP_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"flag":"prompt_edge_v2","enabled":false,"scope":"prod"}'
```

eng-oncall: Executing toggle now. API returned 200 and `state: disabled`. Flag state in UI shows 0% rollout for prompt_edge_v2.

incident-bot: Flag toggle recorded: actor=eng-oncall, action=disable, flag=prompt_edge_v2, request_id=abc123ef, timestamp=1739123480. Autoscale: canary routing set to drain.

maria_g: Support queue: 3 paying customers surfaced errors tied to this route (acme-inc, globex, noonsoft). Opening CS bridge and sending initial notify.

samir: Traffic shifted back to stable, 5xx rate down to baseline within ~40s of toggle. KV cache miss metric still elevated on canary hosts but traffic is drained. Collecting full stack traces to attach to the ticket.

jess: I'll cut a hotfix PR to guard the KV lookup and add a defensive null-check + unit test. Plan: patch -> canary patch -> gradual rollout behind tests. For now keep flag disabled and canaries drained.

eng-oncall: Creating incident ticket INC-2026-045 and adding logs + traces. Handoff: I'll be on for another 30m then pass to @ben_s for overnight monitoring. Please add any follow-ups to the ticket.

ben_s: Taking handoff. Please include the list of affected canary hosts and the SIGTERM/drain sequence you ran. Also add any CS threads for the three customers so I can coordinate follow-up messages.

support-bot: CS update sent: templates delivered to account owners, expected follow-up window 2 hours. Ticket created: CS-6789.

eng-oncall: :white_check_mark: Monitoring. Short-term mitigated by flag disable. Will keep incident open until hotfix is deployed and verified. Postmortem stub: https://issues.redwood.internal/INC-2026-045/postmortem
